text: Tax advisors ( Steuerberater) help you with your personal and business taxes. A tax advisor can: Help you understand your taxes File your tax declaration Help you start a business Prepare documents to renew your freelance visa Take care of your business taxes ( VAT, Gewerbesteuer, …) Tax advisors are legally liable for the advice they give. If they make a mistake, they pay for it.

section: When to hire a tax advisor
text: Hire a tax advisor when… You have a complicated tax situation For example, you have income from multiple countries, income from multiple sources (real estate, investments, stock options), or problems that tax software can’t solve. You want someone to take care of everything They can talk with the Finanzamt, and do all your taxes for you. You don’t have to do anything. This makes your life much easier. You are starting a business A tax advisor can register your business, explain how business taxes work, and help you avoid expensive mistakes. They must also stamp documents for your freelance visa application and renewal. When you understand how to run your business, you can use tax software for freelancers instead. You must renew a freelance visa A tax advisor must prepare and stamp some of the required documents. If you don’t have a tax advisor, Tax Germany can prepare those documents for you. It’s cheaper and faster. You are in trouble If you have problems with the Finanzamt, and you don’t know what to do. They can take care of all communications with the Finanzamt. They can quickly solve your problem. If your salary is your only source of income, you don’t need a tax advisor. You might not need to make a tax declaration, because the Finanzamt already knows how much you earned. You can use ELSTER or tax software to declare tax-deductible expenses.

If you are an employee, you pay € 300 to € 1,000 for a tax declaration. The prices vary a lot. Use this calculator to estimate the costs. If you are self-employed, you must pay more. If you don’t charge VAT, it costs € 300 to € 800 per year. If you charge VAT, it costs € 700 to € 2,000 per year. The prices vary a lot. The only way to know is to call and ask. The cost of a tax advisor is tax-deductible.
Tax advisors are expensive and hard to find. Most of them refuse new clients. There are other ways to do your taxes in Germany.

title: For a few documents
text: If you just need a proof of income to apply for an apartment, or documents to renew your freelance visa, you don’t need a tax advisor. Tax Germany can prepare and stamp those documents. It’s cheaper and faster.

title: Look outside of Berlin
text: Your tax advisor can be anywhere in Germany. It’s easier if you look in other German cities.

title: Tax software
text: Tax software is cheaper and easier than a tax advisor. There are English-speaking options. Tax software is enough if… Your job is your only source of income and you don’t have many tax-deductible expenses and you have simple investments (stocks, ETFs) List of German tax software

title: Bookkeepers
text: Bookkeepers ( Buchhalter) are cheaper than tax advisors, because they are not certified professionals. Anyone can be a Buchhalter. They can help you file your tax declaration, but you must verify their work, and submit the tax declaration yourself. If they make a mistake, it’s your problem. Steuerberater or Buchhalter?

title: Lohn­steu­er­hil­fe­ver­ein
text: A tax help union ( Lohnsteuerhilfeverein) is a non-profit organisation that helps its members file their taxes. They are cheaper than tax advisors, but their competence varies a lot. They might not speak English. The membership costs € 30 to € 300 per year, depending on your income. Only employees can be members, not self-employed people.

title: Hybrid services
text: Some tax software give you access to a tax advisor. You enter your income, expenses and invoices yourself, and a tax advisor reviews them. Taxfix, Zasta and a few other services offer this. This is cheaper than letting a tax advisor do everything. It works well for simple tax situations, but more complex cases are not supported.

title: Freelancer cooperative
text: Smart is a cooperative for freelancers. If you are a member, they take care of invoicing, taxes, and many other things for you. They also give you an employment contract and a steady income. If you want the flexibility of a freelancer and the stability of a job, it’s a good option.
